distinguishing_features: Uses a passive conductive grading or corona ring to redistribute the electric field at a dielectric termination.
Addresses the field-concentration failure mode physically rather than inferring degradation from existing electrical telemetry.
Validates the intervention through partial-discharge inception voltage rather than merely monitoring an insulation-loss signature.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to reduce the local electric-field maximum at a capacitor's dielectric edge or termination sufficiently to suppress partial discharge and dielectric breakdown without increasing dielectric volume.
parsed.viable_reason: Conductive grading and corona rings are physically established means of smoothing the field around high-voltage insulation terminations, and the proposed ring can be implemented and tested at the stated scale.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Applying a corona or grading ring to reduce edge field enhancement is a routine and well-known high-voltage engineering technique, so the distinguishing mechanism would be obvious to a skilled engineer.
